title: Nether On Join Teleport
description: Teleports the player to the nether on join, basically people being locked in the nether.
body:
# Nether On Join Teleport
Teleports a player on join to set coordinates, if the player wasn't in the nether before joining.

# To-Do
Make sure you check the ```config``` folder where will be ```dimensionteleport.json```!
